description: This file defines the CalculatorScientificOperators class, a partial class for the calculator's scientific operators view, handling UI interactions, state changes, and visibility toggling for calculator functions.

classes.name: CalculatorScientificOperators
classes.description: A partial class managing the scientific operators UI in the calculator app, including button states, visibility of trigonometric functions, and error states.

methods.name: CalculatorScientificOperators
methods.description: Constructor initializing components and setting up keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property returning the data context cast to StandardCalculatorViewModel.

methods.name: IsErrorVisualState
methods.description: Property indicating whether the error visual state is active.

methods.name: OpenParenthesisButton_GotFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on open parenthesis button, triggering narrator announcement.

methods.name: ParenthesisCountToString
methods.description: Converts a count of parentheses to string, empty if zero.

methods.name: OnIsErrorVisualStatePropertyChanged
methods.description: Updates visual state based on error state.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Check
methods.description: Handles shift button check event, updating operator row visibility.

methods.name: ShiftButton_Uncheck
methods.description: Handles shift button uncheck event, resetting state and focus.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutShift_Toggle
methods.description: Toggles trig row visibility based on shift toggle.

methods.name: TrigFlyoutHyp_Toggle
methods.description: Toggles trig row visibility based on hyp toggle.

methods.name: FlyoutButton_Clicked
methods.description: Resets trig and hyp buttons and hides flyouts.

methods.name: ShiftButton_IsEnabledChanged
methods.description: Updates operator row visibility when shift button enabled state changes.

methods.name: SetOperatorRowVisibility
methods.description: Sets visibility of operator and inverse operator rows based on shift button state.

methods.name: SetTrigRowVisibility
methods.description: Sets visibility of trig function rows based on shift and hyp toggles.
